mapper.select: select id, system_code, system_name, base_url, health_status, created_at, updated_at from ip_system order by system_code
select id, system_code, system_name, base_url, health_status, created_at, updated_at from ip_system where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into ip_system(system_code, system_name, base_url, health_status) values (#{code}, #{name}, #{baseUrl}, #{status})
mapper.update: update ip_system set system_code = #{code}, system_name = #{name}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, health_status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select target_url from ip_interface where target_system_id = #{systemId}
